verdict.rationale: Rippling documents developer APIs, a sandbox environment, an official CLI, and llms.txt for building custom integrations and apps, showing a real API surface exists. However, none of the evidence claims or demonstrates full UI/API parity — no documentation of API coverage for all UI actions like payroll runs, benefits approvals, or workflow automation. missing for 10: explicit API parity documentation, evidence that all UI actions (payroll approval, benefits changes, workflow builder) are exposed via API, and independent confirmation of parity.
